example / structure: Academic term label such as `Fall 2024`
description: Human-readable academic term label from the source.

description: Sortable academic term code used for chronological ordering.
null meaning: Never NULL; required by the sample filter.

example / structure: Canonical date: YYYY-01-01, YYYY-04-01, YYYY-07-01, or YYYY-10-01
description: Canonical starting date assigned to the academic term.

example / structure: IPEDS institution identifier
description: IPEDS institution identifier used throughout the pipeline.

example / structure: Non-NULL state/province code not exactly empty or `CAN`; whitespace-only values can pass.
description: State or province code for the institution.
null meaning: Never NULL; SQL `NOT IN ('CAN', '')` excludes NULL and the exact values `''` and `CAN` without trimming.

example / structure: IPEDS label such as `Public` or `Private not-for-profit`
description: Institution ownership and governance classification used for reporting.

example / structure: IPEDS label such as `Four or more years`
description: IPEDS award-level classification for the institution.

example / structure: IPEDS size-band label, such as `20,000 and above`
description: IPEDS institutional enrollment-size classification used for reporting.

example / structure: IPEDS sector descriptor, such as `Public, 4-year or above`
description: IPEDS sector classification for the institution.

example / structure: Official IPEDS institution-name text
description: Canonical institution name supplied by IPEDS.

example / structure: Derived institution-type category label
description: Derived institution type used for reporting groups.

example / structure: Non-negative 2024 student count; NULL when unavailable
description: Total institutional enrollment reported to IPEDS for 2024.

example / structure: Non-negative 2024 student count; NULL when unavailable
description: IPEDS 2024 students enrolled in distance education.

example / structure: Institution name; source spelling/casing retained
description: Institution or school name attached to the course.

example / structure: Academic department, such as `Biology`
description: Academic department responsible for the course.

example / structure: Source course number; zeros/suffixes retained
description: Catalog number identifying the course within its department.

example / structure: Source section code; zeros/punctuation retained
description: Source code distinguishing sections of the same course.

example / structure: Course title; source punctuation/casing retained
description: Official title assigned to the course.

example / structure: Exactly `Introductory or general undergraduate` or `Intermediate undergraduate`.
description: Instructional level assigned to the course.
null meaning: Never NULL; required by the sample filter.

example / structure: Source subject, such as `Biology`
description: Subject area assigned to the course.

example / structure: COUNT of canonical master_material section×ISBN items; always >0
description: Canonical course-material items within the section.

example / structure: Whole-number count of at least 1.
description: Required materials within the canonical section.

description: Optional or recommended materials within the section.

description: Whether the section contains retained canonical materials.

description: Canonical included materials within the retained section.

description: No-materials placeholder rows co-occurring with retained sections.

example / structure: ANY_VALUE of repeated canonical per-section Canada indicator
description: Whether the source row belongs to Canada.

example / structure: ANY_VALUE of repeated canonical per-section supply indicator
description: Whether the material is classified as a course supply.

example / structure: ANY_VALUE of repeated canonical per-section supply item count
description: Classified supply rows co-occurring with retained sections.

example / structure: COALESCE(BOOL_OR(is_oer), FALSE) over canonical master_material items
description: Whether the material is an open educational resource.

example / structure: TRUE or FALSE
description: Whether the material uses inclusive access.

example / structure: Non-negative whole-number count
description: Open-resource materials within the aggregation group.

example / structure: Non-negative whole-number count
description: Inclusive-access materials within the aggregation group.

example / structure: LIST(DISTINCT publisher)
description: Distinct publishers represented by the section materials.

description: Distinct publishers of required materials within the section.

description: Distinct publishers of required materials within the section.

example / structure: Non-negative whole-number count
description: Distinct publishers of optional materials within the section.

example / structure: Reported student count; source noise can include negative values

description: Whether the material has a nonblank FormatType classification.

example / structure: canonical items carrying a FormatType

description: Whether a sibling section reports usable occupied seats.

example / structure: Rounded student count from the ladder; raw negatives can propagate
description: Best available section enrollment from the assignment ladder.
